context: A boss runs a team meeting
purpose: Teach: 久保/浩/茂/竹内/後藤/従い/プロトコル/函

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今月の体制、久保さんと浩さんが新プロジェクト主担当。
lines.en: This month, Kubo and Hiroshi will lead the new project.
lines.style: Brisk, businesslike tone. Clear enunciation on the assignments. No hesitation. The confident opening cadence of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。技術側は茂さんと竹内さん。後藤さんがサポート。
lines.en: Understood. On the technical side, we have Shigeru and Takeuchi. Goto will provide support.
lines.style: Steady, note-taking rhythm. Each item lands with quiet clarity. Professional confirmation without flatness — engaged but precise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 手順書に従い、改訂版プロトコルを採用しよう。
lines.en: We'll follow the standard procedure and implement the revised protocol.
lines.style: Measured, directive. Light emphasis on 'revised' — this is the key change. Calm authority. No room for interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 函館支店からも、社内会議に出席です。
lines.en: The Hakodate branch will be joining the internal meeting as well.
lines.style: Straightforward informational tone. Matter-of-fact delivery. A simple addition stated without inflection or emphasis.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Brief, grounded conclusion. Slight forward momentum — the nod that closes a briefing. Quiet confidence in the team.
